nina_csm: Heads-up: ClinicBridge showing renewed friction on long-case conversations. Usage steady but CS reported slower replies during long note stitching. Proposing a proactive pilot: split routing by token length + quantized fallback. Thoughts?

devin_infra: Hosted in prod-us-east. Any compliance flags? KMS usage?

nina_csm: No PHI in sanitized logs but they paste long clinical summaries. They use our standard KMS envelope for a couple enterprise features.

leo_runtime: Pilot outline:
- Route decision: if tokens >= 900 -> send 10% to a quantized 7B fallback, 90% baseline. Short requests stay on baseline.
- Enable prefix KV caching for repeated system prompts.
- Semantic parity checks: 10 customer prompts pre/post canary; alert if semantic_match drops > 0.04.
- Auto-revert triggers: canary_p99 > baseline_p99 + 30ms OR error_rate +0.4%.

leo_runtime: Ops snippet:
{"route":"clinicbridge_q_fallback","conditions":[{"if":"tokens>=900","weights":{"clinic_7b_q":0.1,"clinic_13b":0.9}}],"fallback":{"p99_ms":30,"error_pct":0.4}}

sara_solutions: I'll prepare a short customer note and rollback playbook. Need cost delta estimates and a short QA checklist for header passthrough + idempotency.

nina_csm: Cost estimate: routed quant path ~-35% compute vs baseline; at 10% routing expect ~3% account-level infra savings. We'll propose a 36h pilot starting Mon 09:00 PST.

devin_infra: Make sure the canary path preserves KMS envelope semantics and we tag requests with tenant=clinicbridge and pilot=precisionQ for audit.
